theorems.name: Submission.gram_inverse_range_starProjection
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → K = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → IsUnit (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) ∧ (∀ v w : Rn n, inner ℝ (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) v) w = inner ℝ v (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) w)) ∧ K.starProjection = A ∘L Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
